title: Executor result
description: The outcome of one executor run, written to the factory-named GNOMISH_RESULT_FILE and read through the one capped result reader; stdout and stderr are logs, never this document. Readers ignore unknown properties (additive evolution, protocol version 1). Implements FR1, FR2, FR6 of define-executor-contract; FR2, FR5, NFR-R2 of migrate-verify-to-executor-contract.

status.description: The closed status taxonomy. Unknown-token arm: any other token is read as failed/infrastructure with a reason naming the token.

failureClass.description: Required when status is failed. quality burns an attempt; infrastructure burns none and escalates after retries; limit burns none and ends the stage with a budget-exhausted escalation. Unknown-token arm: read as infrastructure, naming the token.

pendingKey.description: Required when status is pending: the opaque key the factory polls with, handed to the poll in GNOMISH_PENDING_KEY, so at most 4096 characters and no control character; any other key reads as failed/infrastructure. A pending result from a role whose caller cannot poll is failed/infrastructure.

reason.description: Optional free text explaining the status; untrusted text.

details.description: Optional free text carried apart from the reason, such as a log tail or an endpoint's answer; untrusted text. Allowed on any status; the engine reads it for a failed or pending result and ignores it on completed, whose details travel on its SARIF results (design D19 of migrate-verify-to-executor-contract).

pollAfterMillis.description: The wait hint: with status pending only, the fewest milliseconds after this answer before the key is polled again. A lower bound beside the check's interval, never a faster poll, never past the check's timeout; relative, never an instant. Any other place or value reads as failed/infrastructure naming the field.

pendingState.description: The pending state: with status pending only. running — every awaited subject seen, one still running; unreported — an awaited subject never appeared on the polled commit; unobserved — the source could not be read this time, such as a rate limit. A timeout whose last pending answer was unreported or unobserved cannot verify. On another status it reads as failed/infrastructure naming the field. Unknown-token arm: read as absent.

denials.description: The denials the run met (egress and policy refusals); absent means none.

usage.description: What the run consumed, as the executor reports it. ABSENT never renders as zero: an executor that cannot report usage says so. The factory adds role, executor name and vote index when it records the entry.

provenance.description: Unknown-token arm: read as ABSENT, never as zero usage.

models.description: Per resolved model id: the four token counts and an optional cost in USD.

examples.reason: command timed out before it exited and its process tree was killed
